description: TechFabric's published blog posts, newest first, optionally only those with a tag, by an author, or dated on or after a day. Drafts are private: list_drafts lists a signed-in engineer's drafts; a TechFabric engineer connects with Microsoft (the client's Connect or Authenticate button) to list and write them.

author.description: Only posts by this author (name or slug, e.g. Preetham Reddy)

since.description: Only posts dated on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD

tag.description: Only posts with this tag (its name or slug, e.g. Databricks)

name: list_posts
title: List blog posts
